p.src: 1  Remind them to be in subjection to rulers and to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,

en: Remind them to be in subjection to rulers and to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,
u.src: 1  Remind them to be in subjection to rulers and to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,

p.src: 2  to speak evil of no one, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all humility toward all men.

en: to speak evil of no one, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all humility toward all men.
u.src: 2  to speak evil of no one, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all humility toward all men.

p.src: 3  For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.

en: For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.
u.src: 3  For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.

p.src: 4  But when the kindness of God our Savior and his love toward mankind appeared,

en: But when the kindness of God our Savior and his love toward mankind appeared,
u.src: 4  But when the kindness of God our Savior and his love toward mankind appeared,

p.src: 5  not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy, he saved us through the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Holy Spirit,

en: not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy, he saved us through the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Holy Spirit,
u.src: 5  not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy, he saved us through the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Holy Spirit,

p.src: 6  whom he poured out on us richly through Jesus Christ our Savior;

en: whom he poured out on us richly through Jesus Christ our Savior;
u.src: 6  whom he poured out on us richly through Jesus Christ our Savior;

p.src: 7  that being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

en: that being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
u.src: 7  that being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

p.src: 8  This saying is faithful, and concerning these things I desire that you insist confidently, so that those who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men;

en: This saying is faithful, and concerning these things I desire that you insist confidently, so that those who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men;
u.src: 8  This saying is faithful, and concerning these things I desire that you insist confidently, so that those who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men;

p.src: 9  but shun foolish questionings, genealogies, strife, and disputes about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.

en: but shun foolish questionings, genealogies, strife, and disputes about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.
u.src: 9  but shun foolish questionings, genealogies, strife, and disputes about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.

p.src: 10  Avoid a factious man after a first and second warning,

en: Avoid a factious man after a first and second warning,
u.src: 10  Avoid a factious man after a first and second warning,

p.src: 11  knowing that such a one is perverted and sinful, being self-condemned.

en: knowing that such a one is perverted and sinful, being self-condemned.
u.src: 11  knowing that such a one is perverted and sinful, being self-condemned.

p.src: 12  When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me to Nicopolis, for I have determined to winter there.

en: When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me to Nicopolis, for I have determined to winter there.
u.src: 12  When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me to Nicopolis, for I have determined to winter there.

p.src: 13  Send Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey speedily, that nothing may be lacking for them.

en: Send Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey speedily, that nothing may be lacking for them.
u.src: 13  Send Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey speedily, that nothing may be lacking for them.

p.src: 14  Let our people also learn to maintain good works to meet necessary needs, that they may not be unfruitful.

en: Let our people also learn to maintain good works to meet necessary needs, that they may not be unfruitful.
u.src: 14  Let our people also learn to maintain good works to meet necessary needs, that they may not be unfruitful.

p.src: 15  All who are with me greet you. Greet those who love us in faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.

en: All who are with me greet you. Greet those who love us in faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.
